lokele: Simona Petelo, bɔkɔwa la Botomomu wa Yesu Masiya, asotoma lokasa-lo ende bato ebasɔɔlɔ liimeli elile la lokuku lolau kwa eliasu liimeli, ko la liengani lia Mungu wasu la Bouwesi wasu ako Yesu Masiya,
english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, 1:1 to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

lokele: Booto la lilatemi biulweke end’ino, ko la liluwani lioluwa Mungu la Yesu Ngɛnɛ wasu!
english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

lokele: Eoka bofoka wande ebosekwi ende Mungu bosofaef’iso bitotina ebiomani nde la loiko la lisemoli lia Mungu, ko la liluwani lia Inde oyatak’iso lioi ko la tala la likama lia bolau wande,
english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

lokele: ko la yao asotikel’iso basakä bande balau ebalongeli fafo, litina mbo oyaleke la likaɔ lia liluku lia Mungu ani osokwela lifɔndi elikoyali ono nda wenda ko l’eoka ya yɛmɛ ibe. Bakakanelo la beimo ya Petelo ende eb’Etanda
english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

lokele: Limɔ ko l’eoka ya litina-li, fumbaka finɛ ndowachaka boyaeli bolau amamwito la liimeli lianu, amamwito la boyaeli bolau imɔ ko liluwani,
english: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

lokele: amamwito la liluwani imɔ ko likakalesi lia betema yanu, la amamwito la likakalesi lia botema imɔ ko likɔkɔmɛlɛ, la amamwito la likɔkɔmɛlɛ imɔ ko lisemoli lia Mungu,
english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

lokele: amamwito la lisemoli lia Mungu imɔ ko eniya ya bitungani ya Etanda, amamwito la eniya imɔ ko losamɔ.
english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

lokele: Eoka bosɛlɛ nde njasɔ-bi la biulwa end’ino likama, limɔ bitokufesel’ino bowandu la ɛkwɛlɛ nda liluwani lia Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya.
english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lokele: Eoka boto oyasoomelo njasɔ-bi, ambo ale la botuku la atɔɛnɛ ko yao ebile tina lande, asoosala lotaneso loa batwanelo bande ba osooso.
english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

lokele: Eokao, Bitungani fumbaka finɛ ndokɔcha loasɔ loko mbo osotomo lioi la mbo osoaomo la Mungu, eoka bokela ongoma ani ino angokwa imɔ se;
english: Therefore, brothers, 1:10 be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

lokele: ongoma to otofaefomo lifaefela, ko isosha shɔɔtɔ nda bɔkɔta wa layalaya wa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya Bouwesi wasu.
english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

lokele: Eokao, yelaenyeles’ino e-njasɔ-bi mbile la mbile, ani ososila oko ndoluwa yao la ndokɔkɔmɛlɛ kɔkɛ nda wewe ebosoluw’ino.
english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

lokele: Itangi nde mbo losoengana lami, ko la mbile eyetikali lami nda bindo, ndofumbes’ino ko la lienyelesi lia njasɔ-bi,
english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

lokele: eoka isoluwa mbo mbile yosekwa nda bindo yami esoya oko tina, kwa ɛnɛsɛkɛ imɔ Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya wɛnɛsɛ’mi.
english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

lokele: Itofumba to ndokomya mbo mbisa ya liwa liami, ino bokɔkɔlɛkɛ ko mbile la mbile ndoenyakela e-njasɔ-bi.
english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

lokele: Aluwesak’iso oluwes’ino bofoka la loyo loa Ngɛnɛ wasu ako Yesu Masiya, totiatutelaka bembila eyafɔlɔmɔkɔ la wɛlï wa bato, kongo ko twɛnɛkɛ tala yande ya likama.
english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

lokele: Eoka afomoko Inde loinelomo la tala ko ende Mungu Sango, limiki lifi lia Ngɛnɛ wa tala loonga mbo— Oyo ende Wana wami wa losamɔ, oyatoomalesa nde Imi;
english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.” Matthew 17:5

lokele: la iso angɛnɛ twaokaka limiki-li eliasekwaka nda Use, eyayaelak’iso lande nda löngo lotanu.
english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

lokele: Tole imɔ ko la liolo lia litɔndɔli elisokɔkɔmɛsɔmɔ kɔkɛ, eokao bolau ngo ko mbo botinganeke la liao kwa faka eyesoanganga nda elela ya botufɛlɛ ko nd’akasɔsweke buse, ani üonge sha lisɔi sisotɛmwa nda betema yanu.
english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

lokele: Taluwaka to mbo angwɛnɛ litɔndɔli lia Kasa ya Mungu lisoaesomo litina se ko la wɛlï wa boto angɛnɛ kongo,
english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

lokele: eoka litɔndɔli litiayaka ko la lisangi lia boto ko mbile ango ɛmɔi, kongo ko bato angɛnɛ ebatinjakomo ko la Bolimo Botanu, iyo loonga ko la isosha sha Mungu.
english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

lokele: Nde batɔndɔli ba bolimbakeli batɛmwaka sisi ya bato, kwa akayek’imɔ ko baekesi ba bolimbakeli sisi yanu, batoeshel’ino tofenya ko wisisa tosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ Etanda, batoanganya ango Ngɛnɛ oyasoendol’iyo; ongoma batoeshel’iyo angɛnɛ ko lisɛɛsɛli lia lisasaya.
english: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

lokele: Limɔ wike betutaka nde boyaeli wa bolëfë, la eoka yau, mboka ya wewe etomɔlɔkɔmɔ.
english: Many will follow their immoral 2:2 ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

lokele: Limɔ ko la bolole wau batɔsɔkɔ bieto yanu kwa bokalala wa baoi ebatofenyak’iyo la yɛnɔ; nde likuchi liau ko kwaala litiyeke l’imɔngi la lisɛɛsɛli liau litiingale la bolengelenge.
english: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

lokele: Eya to mbo Mungu atiamɛsɛlɛkɛ bakitomo eyatwaneloko iyo, nde koumbokol’iyo nda eyaelo ya Satana, la atak’iyo nda basɛkɔ ba botufɛlɛ wa ndi mbo bakandokomoko ko nda liateli lia njasɔ;
english: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, 2:4 and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

lokele: atiamɛsɛlɛkɛ eba wenda wa kwaala, kongo ko auwesaka Noa ako Boekï wa Liengani buu ko la bato basi osambale ani aeshaka fela efi nda wenda wa bato ebatiluwaneke la Mungu;
english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

lokele: aombesaka Inde bekenge ya Sodomo la Amola ko ndokindola yao ko biuta ko biuta, ongoma Inde lɔsɛlɛ yao ko etichelo ende bato ba mbisa ebakaluwaneke ango la Mungu;
english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

lokele: ɔnɔkɔlɔkɔ imɔ Mungu Loti ewa liengani, oyaokesomoko tale ko la boyaeli wa bolëfë wa bato babe,
english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

lokele: (eoka boto ona wa liengani, ani ayalak’inde sisi yau lise la lise, ɛnɛk’inde la okak’inde bekeeli yau eyatefokolaka Bikela, inde lokaka botema wale finɛ, boko botema wa liengani).
english: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

lokele: Ongoma Ngɛnɛ nd’aluwi ndɔnɔkɔlɔ eba liengani nda lisoshela la ndoundekesa ebati la liengani nda lokuchakelo ko nda lise lia liataki,
english: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

lokele: nde asa kɔni ebatolitekesa yɛmɛ ibe ya bindo ebisobebes’iyo la ebatosɛɔlɔ tososha. Bende la lotendela lobe la etenge, la baitowanga ndomɔlɔkɔ ebatalemi tala;
english: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

lokele: ani bakitomo ebalongeli iyo la bofoka la isosha, angofak’iyo se la limɔli nda baiso ba Ngɛnɛ.
english: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

lokele: Nde e-bato-ba bende kwa nyama ebiti la liluwani ko la boyaeli wa bindo kongo, eyaotomoko ko ndoundakomo kala la ndoolomo, batomɔlɔkɔ njasɔ ebitiluwek’iyo litina, batosɛɛsɛlɛsɔmɔ ko la lɔsɛɛsɛlɔ loa yao,
english: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

lokele: batokelakomo obe ko l’eoka ya bobe ebosokelak’iyo. Batangi nde mbo limɛngɔ ko bilambɔ ya sɔni yolomo ko la löwa. Bende kwa bakɔi la bamɛmɛ babe, basoendaenda nda bilambɔ yanu ya losamɔ.
english: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

lokele: Baiso bau basobalyana l’eba batomali ba nyongo, angotatɛkwa batwanelo, batɔɔngɔlɔ betema ya bato ebatikɔkɔmɛ, eoka betema yau bisoekekesomo ko ndolola yao ebiti eyau.
english: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

lokele: Bana ba mɔlɔ! Basoengwa mboka ya fii, basokaeyaeya okatutaka mboka ya Balaama, wana wa Beola, oyalɛmbɛkɛ finɛ ko bosombo wokamba ebitiengane,
english: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

lokele: nde inde lofomo liɛngɔ ko l’eoka ya eliande litefoli; punda y’euma loonga la limiki lia boto, ongoma yao lokufesa loseka loa bɔtɔndɔli ona.
english: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

lokele: Bende tosolo etoti ango la balia, baumba ebasotinjakomo la lomba; botufɛlɛ wa ndi bosüchelomo iyo.
english: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

lokele: Eoka atoongak’iyo betendele ya likama, batɔɔngɔlɔ bato ebasambosekwa nda bofoka wa ebatokelaka batwanelo, la batɔɔngɔl’iyo ko la yɛmɛ ya bolëfë wa bindo.
english: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

lokele: Batotikel’iyo lisakä lioyala iote, ani iyo angɛnɛ bende bɛkɔwa ya boyaeli wa bɔwɛwɛ; eoka boto ende bɔkɔwa wa inde oyasolongel’inde.
english: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

lokele: Eya to mbo besekwaka nda boyaeli wa wenda-bo ko la liluwani lia Ngɛnɛ la Bouwesi wasu ako Yesu Masiya, limɔ bekandakomo liasi la belongelomo ko la wao, boyaeli wau wa mbisa bosoetela ewa oso la bobe.
english: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

lokele: Eoka bolau wolongela ko mbo ani batialuwaka mboka ya liengani, inga to mbo basekweke nda bikela bitanu eyafaefomoko iyo la eyaluwak’iyo la wɛlï.
english: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

lokele: Wisha wa wewe bosoowanel’iyo boko mbo— Ngwa esoinwela yeka eyesosɛndɛk’inde; la wasi mbo— Ndɛi esosoola bindo, la esoinwa okalɔkwalɔkwa nda baïti.
english: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” Proverbs 26:11 and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

lokele: Ebasamomu, e-lokasa-lo loende eloa imbale elososɔnɛlɛ’mi ino, la nda yaambale isofumbekesa baenyeli balau banu ndoenyeles’ino;
english: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

lokele: mbo otaosala baölo ebaongaka Batɔndɔli batanu ko osooso, la ekela ya Ngɛnɛ la Bouwesi eyaongomoko ko la Batomomu banu.
english: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,

lokele: Taluwaka to loasɔ-lo, mbo nda bacho ba liko, ebatolimbokola beyaka la batolitekesa ko yɛmɛ yau angɛnɛ,
english: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

lokele: la batoonga mbo— ¿Lisakä lia loyo loande ko anima to? Eoka ko nda mbile eyakwaka batata basu tɔlɔ twa liwa bitotina bikotikala kwa ayalaka ngo ko yao ko nda liakoli lia wenda-bo.
english: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

lokele: Nde basoosala loasɔ-lo la yɛnɔ, loko mbo biuse yaaka kwaalakwaala la se imɔ yakelomoko nda balia la ko la balia l’eoka ya lioi lia Mungu,
english: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

lokele: la ko la balia wenda ewayalaka lolindaka la fela, wao losɛɛsɛlɔ.
english: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

lokele: Nde ko la lioi-ao biuse la se ebikoyali kwani bisoukamesomo eoka yofechomo ko la bösä la bisüchelomo lise lia liataki la lɔsɛɛsɛlɔ loa bato ebatiluwane la Mungu.
english: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

lokele: Nde ino, ebasamomu, oosalëke loasɔ-lo lomwito, loko mbo— Ende Ngɛnɛ Mungu, lise limɔi liende kwa miaka bilɛfu, la miaka bilɛfu yende kwa lise limwito end’Inde.
english: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

lokele: Ngɛnɛ wasu ati l’imɔngi shokocha lisakä liande, ani asotanga bato bamɔi mbo imɔngi, nde atoumbakel’ino angowa esole, eoka atilɛmbɛ mbo boto angɔmɔi asɛɛsɛlɛkɛ, kangä mbo batotina biyeleke nda likalangani.
english: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

lokele: Liyaka nde, liko Lise lia Ngɛnɛ, kwa wiya; nda lise lina biuse bilawanjwaka mbao ko la liela lia wambe, liso lia use, la tengai la tolonge bilalangwalangwaka la etao ya likama limɔ wenda la yao ebikelomo ina bilaisolomoko. Boimo la liseeli lia tuu ya lokasa
english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

lokele: Eoka mbo bitotina-bi bilalangwaka ongoma, oondu nde ndoyala boni to bɔfɔnɔ wa bato wa boyaeli botanu la lilitesi liolitesa Mungu,
english: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

lokele: l’ani atoumbakel’ino la yɛmɛ yoendesa loyo loa lise lia Mungu, ko la loao biuse bilafyaka la bilalangwaka la liso lia use, la tengai la tolonge bilalangwaka la etao ya likama.
english: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

lokele: Nde yende ko biuse biyai la wenda boyai ebikolukak’iso la olo akayeleke ko liengani, kwa atikak’Inde angɛnɛ lisakä.
english: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

lokele: Eokao, ebasamomu, akolukak’ino njasɔ-bi fumbaka to mbo Inde oshek’ino l’angwɛnɛ limɛmɛ, angwɛnɛ ango litwanelo, kangä lilatemi.
english: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

lokele: Tangaka mbo liumbakeli lia Ngɛnɛ wasu, liende ko liuwesi, kwani asɔnɔkɔ etungani oyasamomu lasu ako Paulo ɛsɔnɛl’ino ko la wɛlï ewafaefomoko inde,
english: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

lokele: kwa atoongak’inde imɔ nda kasa yande bitotina. Nda yao, bimɔi yende la tale yoluwa litina; eba botutuku, l’ebatikɔkɔmɛ batofenyaka batina, kwa atokelak’imɔ iyo nda kasa yasi ya Mungu ko nda losɛɛsɛlɔ loau angɛnɛ.
english: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

lokele: Eokao to ino ebasamomu, kwa asotaluw’ino njasɔ-bi, lambaka mbo otaengolesomo ko la litwanelo lia bato babe la mbo ino otasekwa nda likɔkɔmɛlɛ lianu angɛnɛ.
english: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

lokele: Nde kondaka nda booto la nda liluwani lia Ngɛnɛ wasu la Bouwesi ako Yesu Masiya. Tala bifomoko end’Inde la kwani la ko nda layalaya!
english: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
